articles.title: Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre Convenes Security & Diplomatic Talks
articles.title_so: Raysal Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Hamza Abdi Barre oo Kulan Muhiim ah ku Qabtay Muqdisho
articles.summary: Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre met with diplomatic envoys in Mogadishu to discuss maritime safety along key Horn of Africa shipping corridors and regional development.
articles.summary_so: Raysal Wasaare Hamza Abdi Barre ayaa ergada caalamiga ah ku laabtay Muqdisho si looga hadlo amniga badaha iyo horumarka gobolka.
articles.content:
MOGADISHU — Prime Minister of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Hamza Abdi Barre, led key government talks in Mogadishu addressing regional development and maritime safety.

The discussions focused on strengthening maritime security along crucial Horn of Africa trade routes, economic bilateral cooperation, and joint regional infrastructure projects.

Prime Minister Barre reaffirmed Somalia's dedication to regional peace, highlighting ongoing security reforms and expanded trade access across the East African Community.
articles.content_so:
MUQDISHO — Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Hamza Abdi Barre ayaa maanta shir heer sare ah ku qabtay magaalada Muqdisho.

Shirkan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray amniga marinnada badaha, ballaadhinta dekedaha, iyo iskaashiga ganacsiga ee Bariga Afrika.

Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka go'an tahay horumarinta ganacsiga iyo adkaynta nabadgelyada gobolka.

articles.title: Premier League & European Football Weekend: Title Race Intensifies Across Serie A and La Liga
articles.title_so: Wararkii Ugu Dambeeyay ee Ciyaaraha: Premier League, Serie A, La Liga, NBA iyo NFL
articles.summary: Key European football matches kick off this weekend across the English Premier League, Italian Serie A, and Spanish La Liga alongside NBA and NFL highlights.
articles.summary_so: Kulamada xiisaha badan ee horyaalada Yurub sida Premier League, La Liga, Serie A iyo ciyaaraha NBA/NFL ayaa todobaadkan si weyn loo wada sugayaa.
articles.content:
LONDON & MADRID — Football fans across Europe and the Horn of Africa are geared up for crucial league matchups this weekend.

In the English Premier League, top contenders fight for points at the summit, while La Liga and Serie A showcase decisive tactical battles. Meanwhile, North American NBA basketball and NFL regular season clashes draw heavy international viewership.
articles.content_so:
LONDON iyo MADRID — Taageerayaasha ciyaaraha ee dunida iyo Soomaaliya ayaa markale isha ku haya kulamada adag ee horyaalada Premier League, La Liga iyo Serie A.

Sidoo kale horyaalada NBA iyo NFL ee Maraykanka ayaa galay marxalado go'aan cusub leh.

articles.title: Red Sea & Gulf Strategic Talks: Yemen Coastal Security & GCC Economic Summit Convenes
articles.title_so: Khaliijka iyo Badda Cas: Wadahadallada Yemen, Sacuudiga, Imaaraadka iyo Qatar
articles.summary: GCC delegates and regional diplomatic envoys gather in Riyadh to address Red Sea maritime navigation, Yemen diplomatic stability, and regional trade corridors.
articles.summary_so: Hogaamiyayaasha dalalka Khaliijka iyo ergooyinka caalamiga ah ayaa ku kulmay Riyaadh si looga hadlo amniga Badda Cas, Yemen iyo ganacsiga gobolka.
articles.content:
RIYADH — Diplomatic representatives from Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states and Red Sea partner nations held high-level discussions in Riyadh.

The summit addressed maritime transit safety across the Bab-el-Mandeb strait, diplomatic efforts regarding stability in Yemen, and regional infrastructure cooperation connecting Gulf economies with the Horn of Africa.
articles.content_so:
RIYAADH — Ergada dalalka Khaliijka (GCC) iyo Badda Cas ayaa kulan muhiim ah ku yeeshay magaalada Riyaadh.

Kulanka ayaa lagu fakaray amniga Badda Cas, bab-el-mandeb, nabadda dalalka Yemen iyo Soomaaliya, iyo ballaadhinta iskaashiga dhaqaalaha gobolka.

articles.title: Horn of Africa Security Review: African Union & Regional Partners Urge Calm in Ethiopia
articles.title_so: Wararkii Ugu Dambeeyay ee Itoobiya: Midowga Afrika oo Baaq Nabadgelyo ah Soo Saaray
articles.summary: International envoys and African Union diplomats convene talks calling for immediate de-escalation, border stability, and peaceful dialogue across regional borders.
articles.summary_so: Danjirayaasha caalamiga ah iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa ku baaqay degenaansho iyo wadahadal lagu dhameynayo xaaladaha ammaan ee gobolka.
articles.content:
ADDIS ABABA — International diplomats and African Union envoys held urgent consultation sessions in Addis Ababa regarding peace and stability across Horn of Africa borders.

The delegation urged all parties to prioritize political dialogue, secure humanitarian access routes, and protect civilian populations along key regional corridors.
articles.content_so: ADDIS ABABA — Ergada Midowga Afrika iyo dublamaasiyiinta caalamiga ah ayaa kulamo deg-deg ah ku yeeshay magaalada Addis Ababa si looga hadlo amniga gobolka.

articles.title: European Union & Horn of Africa Infrastructure Framework Signed in Brussels
articles.title_so: Midowga Yurub oo Barnaamij Cusub ka Bilabay Bariga Afrika iyo Soomaaliya
articles.summary: Delegates in Brussels approved a simplified trade and customs framework designed to streamline freight transit between Europe and Horn of Africa ports.
articles.summary_so: Mas'uuliyiinta Midowga Yurub ee Brussels ayaa ku dhawaaqay barnaamij cusub oo lagu taageerayo dekedaha Bariga Afrika.
articles.content: BRUSSELS — European Union delegates concluded a landmark bilateral agreement in Brussels today to streamline customs procedures and trade corridors with East African partners.
articles.content_so: BRUSSELS — Ergada Midowga Yurub ayaa Brussels ku meel marisay lacag lagu maalgelinayo maamulka iyo xidhiidhka dekedaha Bariga Afrika.

articles.title: Somali Diaspora Communities in London, Europe & US Host Business Forum
articles.title_so: Shirka Ganacsiga Qurba-joogta Soomaaliyeed oo ka Furmay London, Yurub iyo Maraykanka
articles.summary: Somali entrepreneurs, scholars, and youth leaders from London, Europe, and North America gather for an annual economic forum.
articles.summary_so: Aqoonyahanka iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ee UK, Yurub iyo Maraykanka ayaa ku kulsaday shirweynaha maalgashiga iyo teknoolajiyadda.
articles.content: LONDON — Preparations are underway for the annual Diaspora Economic Summit in London and Minneapolis, bringing together entrepreneurs, scholars, and youth leaders.
articles.content_so: LONDON — Hogaamiyayaasha bulshada iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ee UK, Yurub iyo Maraykanka ayaa magaalada London ku yeeshay shirweyne muhiim ah.
